description: RB-01 final-MIME safety regression corpus. Each case is an APPROVED-template reconstruction input (subject/plain_text/safe_html) that the delivery path renders, validates, and reconstructs into the final MIME. Benign cases must reconstruct to the expected SAFE MIME; adversarial cases must FAIL CLOSED (SafetyRejectionError) before any provider call. All payloads are inert synthetic content: hosts are *.invalid / example.com, data: images are 1-pixel stubs, and nothing is ever fetched or sent. The placeholder {{ tracking.training_url }} is rendered to the recipient-bound tracked click URL by the real renderer.
